listing.name: Dragon Valor — dragon-valor-recomp (victor-takai)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream native DragonValor with disc choice/settings and experimental widescreen. No complete two-disc playthrough established in this review. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA SLUS01092 disc1, SLUS01164 disc2.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local owned-input source route: follow the upstream full toolchain/generate/rebuild recipe and DISC.md with the owned USA DragonValor discs, regenerating the translated game code locally before CMake builds. The repository also documents checked-in generatedC/prebuilt releases; those are not approved managed packages. No source build/package/gameplay was qualified by Portcove.
